name: Myla
traits: Energetic inventor, lawful good. Calls stirges 'hungry, icky, blood-sucking bat-things.'
ideals: Progress through clever tinkering and alchemy.
bonds: Laylee (helper). Her injured wings from a stirge attack.
flaws: Heartbroken that brothers Mek and Minn follow Sparkrender.
summary: Winged kobold tinkerer who sells equipment. Brothers defected to Sparkrender.
backstory: One of nine lawful good kobolds at the cloister. Injured wings limit her flight. Experiments with alchemy — Laylee is banned from using alchemical fire.
notes: Sells equipment from the rulebook. Brothers Mek and Minn are at the observatory with blue face paint.
